style_base: Crude hand-drawn cartoon, Ecomonos style, PURE WHITE background, thick black ink outlines, flat colors. A brown cartoon monkey protagonist, huge white round eyes, exactly like the reference image. Exactly two arms and two hands per character. Any text that appears in the image must be in PERFECT SPANISH, never English. Fill the whole frame, no black bars. SCENE: CRITICAL: never draw the number 258 or the word DIAS/DÍAS or a torn-calendar motif unless the scene explicitly describes days/months elapsed — that content belongs to a different video and must never bleed in from the reference image. CRITICAL about the shadow-hacker attacker: its face must ALWAYS stay completely hidden inside the black hood shadow — never draw visible skin, a nose, a mouth, teeth or any facial features, and never let it look like the brown monkey wearing a hoodie. Only two glowing YELLOW eyes are visible, nothing else. Show emotion only through posture, hands, and the shape/angle of the two eyes.
